To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the phenomenon of consciousness and self awareness are generated in the brain by a neural structure called the ultimate monitor, that is located in the frontal lobes of the cerebral cortex.
the phenomenon of conscious awareness of self is generated in a monitor that receives inputs from a number of different sources and is the ultimate in the hierarchy of monitors.

a monitor is a neural structure that provides an individual with an internal display of information about itself and its environment, that monitors are the key mechanisms that underlie the development and aging processes of the conscious self, and that the ultimate monitor that generates the phenomenon we experience as consciousness is the monitor that provides a display of the positions of the body and its parts in space and time.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the mechanisms and functions of the monitors, a network of neural structures that exist in the mammalian cerebral cortex and subcortical structures, that provide the brain with a display of its current internal states, and that provide information about these states to other parts of the brain.
the nature of the neural mechanisms that generate the phenomena of conscious awareness, self awareness, and the sense of time.
the development and aging in humans and other animals of the phenomenon of conscious awareness of self, and of the mechanisms and neural structures involved in its production.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
monitors are a set of neural structures that exist in the mammalian central nervous system in which data derived through the senses and from the memory stores is precisely and accurately displayed.
monitors, which are neural structures in the brain, are the key mechanisms that generate and maintain the phenomenon of consciousness and the phenomenon of self.

consciousness is a phenomenon that is dependent on the presence of a specific monitor that is a part of a network of monitors that exist in the brain of all mammals, and that it is the function of this ultimate monitor to be aware of itself and of the contents of its own awareness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the self is a monitor of a hierarchy of other monitors, the highest of which is the ultimate monitor.

the self, the conscious self, the self that we all know we have, is the result of the activity of a neural network that we have called monitors and that this network is composed of a series of monitors, each of which receives and processes information from other monitors, from the senses, and from the motor system.

the self is a monitor that receives information from a number of other monitors, one of which is a timing monitor, and that it is the awareness of these inputs, especially the awareness of timing inputs, that is the essential ingredient of awareness of self.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain has a network of monitors that provide a detailed and precise display of the positions of parts of the body and external objects and events with respect to each others.
the brain is an extremely complex and dynamic structure that is not a simple computer.
the brain is not a single, unitary organ.
